dialogues.speaker: Oguz
dialogues.text: I'm with the Eremites, hired by the Akademiya to be a guard here.

dialogues.speaker: Oguz
dialogues.text: What's important is the duty of the Eremites, not who I am. We are the only authorized mercenary organization in the entire Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Oguz
dialogues.text: Remember that so you won't get cheated by scammers.

dialogues.speaker: Oguz
dialogues.text: If you need a competent, reliable bodyguard or watchman in Port Ormos, see our Captain Feroz.

dialogues.speaker: Oguz
dialogues.text: He is rather blunt, but will give you good people.
